text:
Cassie Romero: Heads-up team — we ingested a mixed batch this morning: 30 onboarding snippets, 8 support threads, and 12 in-app feedback rows. CS flagged three accounts (NovaGrid, HelioPharm, ParcelCo) as renewal_cohort within 60d. Need a compact prioritized feed for PM + CSMs by EOD: atomic asks, lane (product/infra/enablement), a two-axis score (churn_risk, product_priority), and an 'ask_repro' note if it's a bug. Can someone spin up the first pass?

Omar Ruiz: I can take it. Proposal: ASR -> NLU extract -> human validate low-confidence. CSV columns I think are minimal but actionable:
```
customer,source,ref_id,ask,category,prod_priority (0-10),churn_risk (0-10),enablement_only,ask_repro,evidence_snippet,notes
```
Add `contract_end` when available so PMs see timing. For churn_risk, treat explicit "won't renew" or "pause" language as 10.

Priya Reddy: I'll run diarization+ASR and drop the raw transcripts into Drive. Quick heuristic for extraction: prefer verb phrases starting with verbs ("Add", "Show", "Support") and keep single-sentence 'ask' fields. I'll also mark low ASR_confidence (<0.65) as 'needs-listen'.

Vikram Shah: For prioritization we should compute two derived fields: roadmap_score = prod_priority + frequency*2; escalation_score = churn_risk*2 + prod_priority. Auto-open tickets when escalation_score >= 18 OR churn_risk >=8. For enablement_only true -> do NOT open product ticket; create docs/enablement card instead.

Cassie Romero: Helpful. Also a subtle ask from CS leadership: include a short 'one-line customer quote' when the item has churn_risk >=8 — they want exact wording in the ticket body for exec context. Flag legal_review if the transcript contains pricing numbers or PII.

signal-bot: Uploaded bundle cs_bundle_3287654321.zip -> https://drive.redwood.example/cs/bundles/cs_bundle_3287654321.zip :file_folder:

Omar Ruiz: Starting first-pass on NovaGrid + HelioPharm. Quick sample rows from extraction (first pass):
```
NovaGrid,call,ng_clip_05,"Allow per-route billing toggle in Console","billing",7,9,false,"UI shows aggregate only","'we need per route cost or we can't justify multiple integrations' - acct exec","contract_end=2024-11-30"
HelioPharm,call,hp_02,"Private model pinning for clinical models","infra",9,10,false,"n/a","'this is a compliance blocker for our security team, can't ship without it' - security lead","contract_end=2024-10-12"
ParcelCo,support,pc-219,"Clarify token billing for batch embeddings","billing",5,3,true,"n/a","asked in onboarding workshop","contract_end=2025-01-15"
```

Priya Reddy: Marked 4 clips as needs-listen (low ASR confidence) and one transcript flagged with pricing terms -> added needs-legal. Also annotated timestamps in the Drive transcripts for quick listening.

Vikram Shah: For dedupe/pattern grouping: run fuzzy-match on `ask` text then create pattern_id (ex: pattern-billing-route-01). If cluster_size >=3 create a single pattern-card linking to evidence. PMs prefer grouped signals.

Omar Ruiz: Will implement pattern grouping. Suggest automation rules to prototype: 
- IF escalation_score >=18 OR churn_risk>=8 -> auto-open ticket in product queue with tag 'customer-voice-escalation' and CC CSM + account exec. Include one-line customer quote + contract_end.
- IF enablement_only==true -> create card in cs-enablement board and assign to Enablement lead.
- IF pattern cluster_size>=3 AND average_prod_priority>=6 -> create pattern ticket for PMs with consolidated evidence.

Cassie Romero: Small UX ask for the automation: tickets should include a short 'suggested_owner' field (product/infra/docs) and an estimated_effort hint (S/M/L) based on category. Helps PMs route quickly.

Priya Reddy: Adding a confidence column (high/med/low) so downstream readers know which rows were auto-extracted vs manually validated. Also tagging 'audio_quality' brief note for any 'needs-listen' rows.

Omar Ruiz: Pushed interim CSV to Drive: cs_voice_extract_3287654321.csv -> https://drive.redwood.example/cs/exports/cs_voice_extract_3287654321.csv. Basic dedupe done; created preliminary pattern_ids for repeated billing asks.

Vikram Shah: Quick sample automation ticket body sketch (for PMs):
```
Customer: NovaGrid (contract_end=2024-11-30)
Ask: Allow per-route billing toggle in Console
Why: 'we need per route cost or we can't justify multiple integrations'
Evidence: ng_clip_05 (transcript link)
Score: roadmap_score=11, escalation_score=25
Suggested owner: Product - billing
Estimated effort: M
Notes: churn_risk high -> escalate to CS leadership
```

Cassie Romero: Perfect. Action items: Omar finish second pass + finalize pattern grouping by 3pm; Priya finish low-confidence listens and add quotes/legal flags by 4pm; Vikram prepare automation rule drafts for the triage meeting. I'll prepare the 1-slide brief for PM + CS leads highlighting the 3 renewal_cohort customers and top 5 escalations.

Priya Reddy: On it. One blocker: two transcripts are missing speaker metadata — if we need speaker role (CS vs customer) for context I'll try to infer from audio but may mark those rows as 'role_unknown'.

signal-bot: Reminder: CS->Product triage in 90 minutes. Agenda auto-added: "cs_bundle_3287654321: top escalations + pattern-candidates".

Omar Ruiz: Thanks team — ping me if you find more renewal flags. Will update the CSV after the manual listen pass.

Cassie Romero: Thanks all :thumbsup: We'll review the automation rules in the triage and confirm the threshold for auto-ticketing.
